decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:11625/0111625/0211625/0311625/0410225/11D11625/SPFlood Risk AssessmentEnergy Statement Planning StatementReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture as specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.

Notwithstanding the approved drawings, the historic lintel on the gable frontage shall be retained and reused for the new fenestrations. Prior to the commencement, amended drawings reflecting this shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The works shall thereafter be carried out in accordance with the approved details. Reason: To ensure an acceptable appearance having regard to the character and appearance of the Enfield Town Conservation Area.

Prior to their installation, large-scaled drawings of the new windows at a scale of in between 1:1 to 1:20, by elevation and section, shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority. The works shall thereafter be carried out in accordance with the approved details.Reason: To ensure an acceptable appearance having regard to the character and appearance of the Enfield Town Conservation Area.

The development must achieve reduced water consumption through the use of water efficient fittings, appliances and recycling systems to result in consumption equal to or less than 105 litres per person per day unless otherwise submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To promote water conservation and efficiency measures in all new developments and where possible in the retrofitting of existing stock in accordance with Policy SI 5 of the London Plan (2021) and Policy CP21 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010).

The residential unit hereby approved shall achieve a minimum of a 35% reduction in CO2 emissions above the levels set in Building Regulations Part L 2021. The installed measures shall be retained permanently.Reason: In the interest of sustainable development and to ensure that the Local Planning Authority may be satisfied that CO2 emission reduction targets are met in accordance with Policy CP20 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), Policies DMD49, DMD50 and DMD51 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).

Prior to first occupation, the covered and secured cycle parking, as indicated on the approved plans shall be installed and ready for use. They cycle parking shall be maintained as such thereafter.Reason: To ensure the provision of cycle parking in line with the Council's adopted standards.

Prior to first occupation, waste storage and recycling facilities to satisfy the future number of occupiers on site shall be provided within the development, in accordance with the Enfield's Household Recycling and Waste Planning Guidance for New Developments (February 2024). Such facilities to be retained for the lifetime of the development.Reason: To ensure that adequate waste and recycling storage facilities are provided to meet the needs of future occupiers, promote sustainable waste management practices, and support borough-wide recycling targets.
